title: Derive visible construction and texture phase from shared physical datums
trigger: wall floor ceiling stair corner seam lip notch inset z-fighting tiling texture phase construction math
guidance: Treat geometry placement and tiling as one construction problem. Establish the installed units, finished floor/slab/wall faces and texture datum; derive segment extents and UV phase from that basis across adjoining pieces. Classify a defect as missing volume, duplicate/coplanar surface, UV phase or shading before repairing it. Give each exposed joint/corner one owner and verify actual opposing faces. Try a geometry-preserving UV correction before changing structural dimensions; dimension changes require a door/stair/floor-frame/collision/save impact check. The owner's block-building analogy asks for coherent construction math, not mandatory voxels or Minecraft dimensions. Rafters or trim may complete a designed joint but must not conceal unresolved substrate errors.
